curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: value the role of legible handwriting in written communication.

interactions.prompt: Mwalimu writes three versions of ‘time’ on the chalkboard. Tap the one that is easiest to read.
choices: t i m e with overlapping letters
interactions.feedback: Yes! Clear, complete letters help us read.
interactions.retryHint: Choose the complete word with letters that do not overlap.

interactions.prompt: Put the neat-writing actions in order.
items: Sit well and hold the pencil
Start each letter at the guide point
Leave a small space between words
answer: Sit well and hold the pencil
Start each letter at the guide point
Leave a small space between words
interactions.feedback: Great! These habits make writing legible.
interactions.retryHint: Prepare first, form letters next, then check spacing.

interactions.prompt: Trace the word ‘clock’ along the letter paths.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap c, l, o, c, k in order.
interactions.feedback: Nice work! Every letter in clock is clear.
interactions.retryHint: Follow one letter at a time from left to right.

interactions.prompt: Which sentence is easiest for a friend to read?
interactions.feedback: Correct! Clear letters and spaces carry the message.
interactions.retryHint: Look for a sentence with a space between every word.

interactions.prompt: Write ‘It is noon.’ neatly on a message card for your family at home.
interactions.tapAlternative: Tap It, is, noon. in order, then copy the sentence neatly.
interactions.feedback: Excellent! A reader can understand your time message.
interactions.retryHint: Copy each letter and keep spaces between the words.

choices: So readers can understand our message
So words can touch each other
interactions.answer: So readers can understand our message
interactions.feedback: Exactly! Legible writing makes communication clear.
interactions.retryHint: Think about the person who will read your work.
